sloka: तस्याहम् करुणम् श्रुत्वा निशि लालपतो बहु ।सम्भ्रानतः शोकवेगेन भृशमास विचेतनः ॥२-६३-३७॥
transliteration: tasyāham karuṇam śrutvā niśi lālapato bahu ।sambhrānataḥ śokavegena bhṛśamāsa vicetanaḥ ॥2-63-37॥

translations.english: Having heard his pathetic lamentations at night, I was extremely frightened by the force of grief and stood bewildered.
